# Emitter worklist — what to sweep next

**Generated by `tools/agx-isa/emit_worklist.py`; do not hand-edit.**

The emittability headline counts instructions an implementer can emit. This file answers the question a dispatch actually needs: *which field do I sweep to move the next instruction across the line.* Ordered closest-first.

A field is emitter-grade only at `hardware-run` or `isolated-byte-diff` (`docs/evidence-classification.md`). Promotion requires two gated runs at **>=99%% per-value cross-run agreement AND movement >= 2x the disagreement count** — and a field that never moves is only promotable if the carriers differ **in the dimension the field controls**. Two carriers identical in that dimension are one carrier (EXP-0164; `iter_at.loc` read inert only because every carrier was `samples=1`).
